_about: The only Node.js base binaries build-sea.mjs will turn into BrainFactorySetup.exe. Keyed by process.version, then <platform>-<arch>.
Each sha256 is copied from the official nodejs.org SHASUMS256.txt of that release (the 'official_name' line), never from a local file.
Add a release by fetching https://nodejs.org/dist/<version>/SHASUMS256.txt and copying the win-x64/node.exe line; a pin change is a reviewed change.

win32-x64.authenticated_by: HTTPS fetch of SHASUMS256.txt; the release-key signature (SHASUMS256.txt.asc) was NOT verified
win32-x64.observed: equals the sha256 of the node.exe installed by the official MSI on the build PC (C:/Program Files/nodejs/node.exe) on 2026-09-26
